subject: Visible loss-result clarity and pictured party readiness consistency
scope: Pixel-only before/after review of the four expressly supplied full native 1920x1080 loss-result stills.

reviewer.name: Hypatia
reviewer.role: retained original independent code-blind visual judge

before.visible_context: Both views explicitly state 'Your creature is out of the fight' over the scene and 'Sparkit is out of the fight' near the bottom. These pixels support an out-of-fight presentation assessment.
before.reason: The large orange message is readable but floats directly over the scene without a separate loss-result panel. Sparkit's highlighted roster row still has a full-looking green bar, matching the ready-looking bars of the other four creatures. That row conflicts with the explicit Sparkit out-of-fight text. TEAM 5/5 itself is not treated as a readiness count.

after.visible_context: Both views show a distinct orange-bordered dark card headed 'Fight lost', with 'Your creature is out of the fight'. The lower message names Sparkit as out of the fight.
after.reason: The named loss result is contained in a clear panel, separate from the party list, quest card and exploration controls. Sparkit's row is visibly dimmed, carries a prominent orange KO badge and has an empty-looking grey bar. This differentiates its unavailable state from the four green-bar rows and removes the pictured full-green Sparkit contradiction. TEAM 5/5 remains visible without overriding the explicit individual KO state.
bounded_positive_findings: Readable, explicitly named loss acknowledgment in both supplied after views.
Non-colour KO label and dimmed/empty-bar treatment consistently identify Sparkit as unavailable.
Other roster entries remain individually distinguishable; no assumption that they also fell is made.

current_rating.severity_reason: The named loss/readiness contradiction is not observed in the supplied after views. Severity 1 is the requested 1–5 scale minimum, not an assertion of a remaining observed defect.
current_rating.exposure_reason: This is an episodic end-of-fight result presentation rather than a continuously displayed fight cue. The rating is a qualitative exposure estimate, not measured campaign frequency.
current_rating.importance_reason: Players need to distinguish a lost fight and an unavailable companion from ready roster entries; result and availability comprehension are important.
current_rating.independence: Assigned from these four expressly inspected full rasters and the previously inspected written UI/readability bar. No prior numeric values or other-row rating was read or transplanted.

evidence.reference_basis: Previously inspected approved Stormwood boards and written ART_DIRECTION/UI/readability bar.

limits: The images support visible result wording, panel separation and roster-state consistency only. They do not establish natural cause, runtime outcome classification, damage/death correctness or an earned defeat.
No continuous fall animation, result timing, duration, dismissal, input behavior or recovery transition is assessed.
TEAM 5/5 may describe owned roster count; it is not treated as proof that all five are ready. The specific Sparkit row and KO treatment are the relevant visible cues.
The trainer's separate 100/100 heart display is not mistaken for Sparkit's creature health.
No other-party wipe, co-op eligibility, saved state, device readability, other resolutions, broad layout quality, full visual bar, READY or whole-criterion acceptance follows from this bounded PASS.
Before and after world framing differs; this is a visible UI/readiness comparison, not an exact world-pixel match or a cause assessment.
preservation: Only this new artifact is written. Historical loss verdict, catalogue, all other rows, previous witnesses, assemblies and whole-criterion evidence remain untouched.
